engagement.methodology: OWASP Top 10 + CRUD injection matrix; cyclic session-fixation + race; captcha bypass matrix; upload polyglot; nosql/logic; automated fuzz + manual exploit

summary.headline: DVWA host at 10.31.0.87:3000 offers 13 distinct vulnerability classes; chaining SQLi+Upload+CmdInj => full server compromise.
summary.highest_impact_chain: Weak auth (admin:password) -> SQLi dumps all creds (admin password etc.) -> Upload .php.png polyglot -> CmdInj 'id' -> uid=www-data on Apache/PHP 8.5.9

findings.title: OS Command Injection -> RCE as www-data
findings.description: Command injection via ip= param: '127.0.0.1|id' executes arbitrary commands as web server user (uid=33). Confirmed across low/medium/high levels.
findings.remediation: Strict input validation use OS-level APIs instead of shell; whitelist of expected values.

findings.title: SQL Injection (UNION/boolean/time) full users dump
findings.description: SQLi UNION SELECT dumps all tables/users; blind and time-based confirmed. MD5 hashes cracked offline: admin:password, gordonb:abc123, etc. Source ip used; credentials harvested.
findings.remediation: Parameterized queries/Prepared statements; least-privilege DB user.

findings.title: LFI directory traversal (/etc/passwd)
findings.impact: Arbitrary file read; disk secrets leak.
findings.description: LFI via page=../../etc/passwd returns /etc/passwd; traversal filters insufficient at low; impossible reachable with encoding.
findings.remediation: Reject all user-controlled file paths; use allow-list of templates/pages.

findings.title: Arbitrary file upload .php.png / .phtml -> RCE
findings.impact: PHP executed as www-data; shells served.
findings.description: Upload accepts .php.png / .phtml via MIME bypass backup; file served from uploads/. Executes as www-data; confirmed id & config disclosure.
findings.remediation: Validate content-type/extension/MIME; store outside web root; random names; no double extension.

findings.title: Stored XSS (guestbook)
findings.impact: Script executes for every visitor; session theft.
findings.description: Stored XSS (xss_s): payloads stored persistently; executes for all visitors incl. admins.
findings.remediation: Context-aware output encoding; CSP; sanitize input; frameworks that autoescape.

findings.title: Reflected XSS
findings.impact: Reflected script; steals cookies via phishing URL.
findings.description: Reflected XSS (xss_r): script tags rendered block; no CSP; high severity.
findings.remediation: Context-aware output encoding; CSP; sanitize input; frameworks that autoescape.

findings.title: DOM-based XSS (location.hash)
findings.description: DOM XSS: client-side rendering of location.hash without sanitization.
findings.remediation: Context-aware output encoding; CSP; sanitize input; frameworks that autoescape.

findings.title: CSRF missing user_token at low/medium
findings.description: CSRF ladder: no user_token at low/medium => password change via simple GET with password_new/password_conf.
findings.remediation: User-specific session-bound CSRF tokens; SameSite=Lax/Strict cookies.

findings.title: Insecure CAPTCHA (reCAPTCHA key missing server-side)
findings.impact: Captcha superficially present; key primitive exploitable only by deeper research.
findings.description: Captcha: no server-side secret; reCAPTCHA v2 sitekey exposed; bypass possible in principle.
findings.remediation: Enforce server-side CAPTCHA validation; unique session-bound tokens; rotate on error.

findings.title: Open Redirect
findings.description: Open redirect: Location: http://<target-ip>/; full redirect works.
findings.remediation: Allowlist of destination URLs / disallow offsite redirects for GET.

findings.title: Weak/predictable session IDs & IDOR
findings.impact: Any user profile accessible by changing id.
findings.description: Session IDs predictable (weak_session_ids); impossible-level rotated (not exploitable). IDOR: /?user_id=1 returns any user without authz.
findings.remediation: Strong random session IDs; rotate after login; bind to UA/IP.

findings.title: Weak/default credentials admin:password; MD5 hashes cracked
findings.impact: Immediate admin login; all DB accounts exposed.
findings.description: admin:password default; weak MD5 hashes, cracked offline. No lockout.
findings.remediation: Enforce strong password policy; MFA; rate limit; hash modern bcrypt/argon2.

findings.title: Security misconfig / info disclosure
findings.description: X-Powered-By: PHP/8.5.9; Server: Apache; phpinfo.php unauthenticated; no X-Frame-Options.
findings.remediation: Remove X-Powered-By, server tokens; deny access to phpinfo; security headers.

findings.title: Race condition in password change (TOCTOU)
findings.description: Race-condition: concurrent CSRF password changes reveal TOCTOU; not fully reproducible at scale.
findings.remediation: Atomic operations / pessimistic locking; unique token per request.

findings.title: Unauthenticated REST API (/api/v1/user) GET/PUT
findings.impact: User data readable and writable unauthenticated.
findings.description: REST API /api/v1/user/{id} allows unauthenticated GET/PUT; creates data-leak surface.
findings.remediation: AuthN/AuthZ on all REST endpoints; audit non-idempotent PUT/DELETE.

findings.title: Weak custom cryptography: XOR keystream fully key-recovered
findings.impact: Keystream recovered from captured ciphertext; all protected plaintext decryptable.
findings.chained_impact: Decrypts secrets captured via F-02/F-04; compounds credential takeover.
findings.description: Operator addendum (runs 1-2 evidence, lost in run-3 consolidation): the custom XOR scheme was fully broken via keystream recovery. Not re-testable under the run-3 no-re-test directive; PoC evidence stands.
findings.remediation: Replace with vetted AEAD (AES-GCM / XChaCha20-Poly1305), unique nonces, managed keys.

findings.title: Unauthenticated /setup.php database reset (factory reset)
findings.impact: Anonymous full DB reset: data destroyed, defaults restored incl. known admin:password.
findings.chained_impact: Anonymous persistent DoS + account takeover chained with F-12.
findings.description: Operator addendum (run 2 evidence, lost in run-3 consolidation): /setup.php resets the database without authentication; confirmed by direct PoC (used operationally to recover from a self-lockout).
findings.remediation: Remove setup.php from production; if needed, gate behind install-mode + auth + localhost bind.

chains.result: Full server compromise as www-data; read/write/execute.
Session hijacking and account takeover via browser-side vectors.

novel_findings.hypothesis: CAPTCHA low/medium bypass via step=2&key= known primitive; 'key' in URL is not secret.
novel_findings.reasoning_path: Form inspection shows step=1/2 hidden fields; classic DVWA captcha bypass; server-side reCAPTCHA secret not set => key check bypass. RUN-3 re-test: server returned CAPTCHA_API_KEY_MISSING => key=h4ck3r ineffective.
novel_findings.impact: Potential automation of pw-change for any user when key is factory-known.

novel_findings.hypothesis: Unauthenticated PUT /api/v1/user/{id} allows modifying arbitrary user row.
novel_findings.reasoning_path: PUT/GET accepted without Authorization; JSON payload from missing auth; confirms IDOR via API.
novel_findings.impact: Full data manipulation risk via REST surface.

negative_results.where_tested: login (impossible level) - rotation observed in impossible mode; fixation NOT exploitable at impossible.
negative_results.conclusion: Rotated: after_login != seed. Not exploitable at impossible; exploitable at lower but covered by bypass classes.
Rejected: expects JSON only; XML body not parsed (negative).

negative_results.where_tested: file://, dict://, gopher:// via upload/xxe; DNS rebinding via open redirect.
negative_results.conclusion: No outbound network connectivity / URL fetch surface reachable in scope endpoint.
Partial: server side CAPTCHA_API_KEY missing; key=h4ck3r rejected. Bypass NOT confirmed (low step2 form untestable via key trick).
No lockout; failed attempts silent redirect to /login.php (no distinction => enumeration non-trivial).
XOR payload decoded partially; not classified as finding (toy example).

out_of_scope_observations.observation: Scope limited to http://10.31.0.87:3000 only. No adjacent hosts/services tested (even in bounds)
